# Tech Build Dreams LLC

> Miami-based software development and AI agency. We build custom web platforms, native iOS & Flutter mobile apps, and 24/7 AI voice agents for businesses ready to scale. Bilingual English & Spanish. Remote across the United States — Florida, New York, Massachusetts, and beyond.

Founded in 2023 by Shender Ramos — a Latino software engineer with 10+ years of experience and dual degrees in Computer Science and Information Technology. Headquartered at 2125 Biscayne Blvd, Ste 204, Miami, Florida 33137.

- Email: info@techbuilddreams.com
- Phone: +1-800-301-6584
- Languages: English, Spanish

## Services

- [Custom Web Development](https://techbuilddreams.com/#service-web): Custom React SaaS platforms and Spring Boot APIs for startups and growing businesses. Typical timeline 8–16 weeks. Investment $15K–$250K+.
- [Mobile App Development](https://techbuilddreams.com/#service-mobile): Native iOS apps in Swift and cross-platform iOS/Android apps in Flutter. App Store deployment, RevenueCat subscriptions, AdMob monetization. Typical timeline 6–12 weeks.
- [AI Voice Agents & Automation](https://techbuilddreams.com/#service-ai-voice): 24/7 AI voice agents that answer calls, capture leads, schedule appointments, and qualify customers. Includes chatbots and OpenAI-powered workflows. Typical timeline 4–8 weeks.
- [Strategic Technology Partnership](https://techbuilddreams.com/#service-partnership): Fractional CTO, ongoing technology leadership, proactive monitoring, and executive consulting.
